item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence that Biden empowered technocrats and professional administrators in 2024.\nI found weaker evidence that he personally selected staff through a rigorous capability filter at the campaign/White House top level.\nThe main negative signal is a loyalist inner circle that filtered information after the debate, not a broad pattern of obviously incompetent cabinet appointments.","evidence":[{"title":"Brown economist, education scholar appointed to White House Council of Economic Advisers","publisher":"Brown University","date":"July 24, 2024","url":"https://www.brown.edu/news/2024-07-24/matthew-kraft","summary":"Biden appointed Matthew Kraft, an academic economist, to the CEA to provide real-time, objective evidence and analysis. This is strong evidence of merit-based staffing.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2"]},{"title":"Press Gaggle by Secretary of the Treasury Janet L. Yellen in Anchorage, Alaska","publisher":"U.S. Department of the Treasury","date":"April 3, 2024","url":"https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy2219","summary":"Yellen said Biden charged her with stabilizing the U.S.-China economic relationship and Treasury created working groups to do it. This shows Biden empowering a serious professional with a specific mandate.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"U.S. Department of Education Announces FAFSA College Support Strategy to Deploy Federal Personnel, Funding, and Resources","publisher":"Federal Student Aid / Education Department","date":"February 6, 2024","url":"https://fsapartners.ed.gov/knowledge-center/library/electronic-announcements/2024-02-06/us-department-education-announces-fafsa-college-support-strategy-deploy-federal-personnel-funding-and-resources-support-colleges-students-and-families-better-fafsa-form","summary":"The department deployed federal personnel, funding, and technical expertise to fix FAFSA processing and help schools package aid. That is direct evidence of competent administrative empowerment.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2"]},{"title":"Biden-Harris Administration Announces First-Ever Consortium Dedicated to AI Safety","publisher":"NIST","date":"February 8, 2024","url":"https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/02/biden-harris-administration-announces-first-ever-consortium-dedicated-ai","summary":"Biden’s AI order was turned into a 200+ stakeholder consortium tied to red-teaming, evaluations, and risk management. This is strong evidence of empowering experts and institutions.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2","8B.3"]},{"title":"Biden-Harris Administration Announces Preliminary Terms with Microchip Technology","publisher":"U.S. Department of Commerce","date":"January 4, 2024","url":"https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/01/biden-harris-administration-announces-chips-preliminary-terms-microchip","summary":"CHIPS became an implementation machine with due diligence, plant expansions, job targets, and milestone tracking. This shows Biden backing capable administrators to execute a major industrial program.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Biden-Harris Administration Announces Preliminary Terms with Samsung","publisher":"U.S. Department of Commerce","date":"April 15, 2024","url":"https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/04/biden-harris-administration-announces-preliminary-terms-samsung","summary":"Commerce used a rules-based CHIPS structure and milestone funding to push semiconductor capacity and a Texas manufacturing ecosystem. That points to technocratic execution rather than patronage.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Department of Justice Finds Civil Rights Violations in Phoenix Police Department and City of Phoenix","publisher":"U.S. Department of Justice","date":"June 13, 2024","url":"https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-finds-civil-rights-violations-phoenix-police-department-and-city-phoenix","summary":"DOJ used career attorneys and staff to carry out a formal pattern-or-practice investigation and public findings. This is evidence of capable enforcement personnel being used to execute federal rights policy.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"FTC Announces Rule Banning Most Noncompetes","publisher":"Federal Trade Commission","date":"April 23, 2024","url":"https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/04/ftc-announces-rule-banning-noncompetes","summary":"Biden empowered FTC rulemaking to advance worker mobility and competition. That is evidence of selecting and backing capable regulatory actors.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: Negotiated Prices Initial Price Applicability Year 2026","publisher":"CMS","date":"August 1, 2024","url":"https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/fact-sheets/medicare-drug-price-negotiation-program-negotiated-prices-initial-price-applicability-year-2026","summary":"CMS used a structured negotiation process with public input and patient-focused review, showing professional program management rather than ad hoc direction.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"DOD sends report to Congress on the nuclear weapons employment strategy of the United States","publisher":"U.S. Department of Defense","date":"November 15, 2024","url":"https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3966543/dod-sends-report-to-congress-on-the-nuclear-weapons-employment-strategy-of-the/","summary":"The updated nuclear guidance stressed escalation management, allied consultation, and integration of non-nuclear capabilities. This is evidence of disciplined security staffing and command professionalism.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Chaos swirling since Biden’s debate flub is causing cracks in a White House known for discipline","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"July 9, 2024","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/chaos-swirling-since-bidens-debate-flub-is-causing-cracks-in-a-white-house-known-for-discipline/","summary":"AP described a loyal inner circle, family influence, and scripted communications, which suggests a constricted decision environment rather than broad empowerment of the best available people.","question_ids":["8B.4","7B.10","8B.3"]},{"title":"Why Biden aides are worried about his inner circle","publisher":"Axios","date":"July 12, 2024","url":"https://www.axios.com/2024/07/12/biden-election-inner-circle-withdrawal-criticism","summary":"Axios reported that a shrinking set of loyal “yes” people was filtering negative information from reaching Biden. That is the clearest negative signal on whether the best advisors were truly empowered.","question_ids":["8B.4","7B.10","8B.3"]},{"title":"The final days: How Biden and his inner circle blew it","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"July 21, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/the-final-days-how-biden-and-his-inner-circle-blew-it-3528027","summary":"Reuters described strategic missteps by the campaign team and White House aides that amplified doubts about Biden’s ability to run again or govern for four more years. This cuts against a clean competence story for the ruling network.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.1"]},{"title":"Biden tells Hill Democrats he 'declines' to step aside and says it's time for party drama 'to end'","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"July 8, 2024","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-tells-hill-democrats-he-declines-to-step-aside-and-says-its-time-for-party-drama-to-end/","summary":"Biden resisted mounting internal pressure to change course, which suggests some mismatch between his chosen advisers and the party’s judgment about campaign capability.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3"]},{"title":"Biden goes off script - again - causing a distraction for Harris in campaign’s home stretch","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"October 29, 2024","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-goes-off-script-again-causing-a-distraction-for-harris-in-campaigns-home-stretch/","summary":"AP portrayed repeated off-script remarks as a distraction for Harris and a sign Biden was trying to rein himself in, which weakens confidence in his ability to deploy disciplined political operators late in 2024.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3"]},{"title":"US identified 500 cases where its weapons harmed Gaza civilians but hasn’t taken action","publisher":"Reuters via The Guardian","date":"October 30, 2024","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/30/civilian-harm-us-weapons-israel-gaza-war","summary":"Weak follow-through on many civilian-harm cases suggests that even where Biden had capable enforcement structures, the relevant officials were not fully empowered to act decisively.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","7B.10"]},{"title":"Biden seeks to cancel some interest on student loans, aiding 23 million Americans","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"April 8, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/biden-seeks-to-cancel-some-interest-on-student-loans-aiding-23-million-americans-3368853","summary":"Reuters reported the White House framed the policy around young voters, which suggests some tactical campaign logic mixed into staffing and policy execution choices.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.1"]}]}
